g.text: A traveling sinusoid advances one wavelength during each period

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Lossless uniform-medium traveling wave using cos(ωt−βz), which propagates in+z. ω=2πf and constant phase gives dz/dt=ω/β=v_p. Phase reference atz=0,t=0 is
a positive peak. Snapshot shows spatial variation, not a time waveform; velocity is assumed and need not equal vacuum light speed. Envelope/group velocity
